name: Release quick path replays the manual golden path through historical blockers
trigger: Replay the golden quick-pass DAG with seeded fake runners, inject each historical blocker alone and all together, the must-stop controls, a stalled update-all, resume from every step, and a slow failing parallel branch.
observe: advisory blockers end as warn plus a card and the release publishes
build/publish/npm non-zero, security-4, and NO-GO stop the run and nothing new starts after them
update-all without progress wakes REL at start + 15 minutes
resume from any step reruns only its descendants and publishes at most once
expected: All 13 historical blockers continue and publish, all 5 controls stop, the DAG is faster than manual serial, and publish never starts before prepare, go and notes-public.
